title: Uncertainty Principle for distributions with Fourier transform in $L_{p,q}(\mathbb{R}^d)$
summary: A version of the Uncertainty Principle says: There does not exist a non zero function in $L_p(\mathbb{R}^d)$ if its Fourier transform is supported by a set of finite $α$-Hausdorff measure with $α \frac{q}{2(q-1)}$.
